title: Ko te Tangata i piko ai te rangatiratanga ki ōna tohu
intro: He haerenga whakamiharo kei te tatari atu ki te hunga e maia ana ki te whakaoti i tēnei mea ngaro. I roto i ngā whārangi o te Whakakitenga, i noho tētahi rangatira, ā, ko tana tūtakitanga ki tētahi poropiti ka huri i te āhua o tētahi iwi katoa. I whakahaere tēnei tangata mai i tētahi torona tawhiti, i arahina e ngā tikanga tawhito, tae noa ki tētahi wā whakamiharo o te pono atua i huri ai te rangatira me te kingitanga ake ake. Ka hurahia e koe te tuakiri o tēnei wairua whakamiharo, ko tana kōrero e hono ana i te mea whakamiharo me te mea hohonu?
clues: I whakahaere ahau i tētahi iwi whai rawa i tērā taha o ngā wai tawhiti, i rongonui mō ā mātou māra me tō mātou whare rangatira teitei.
I tino teitei tōku mana, heoi i tae mai tētahi rangatiratanga nui ki te wero i tō mātou oranga me tō mātou tuakiri.
I kawea mai e tētahi manu iti tētahi karere whakamiharo, ā, nā ngā mea whakamiharo i whai mai i pakaru ai aku whakaaro katoa mō te mana.
I taku kitenga i tētahi torona kua hurihia i mua i ōku kanohi, i mōhio ahau kāore he tangata e whai mana pēnei.
I whakapuakina e au taku ngohengohe ki te Ariki Kotahi o te rangi me te whenua, me te whakarērea hoki o ngā mea katoa i arohaina e au i mua.
I tahuri ke tātou, hei iwi, i te karakia rā onamata, ā, i awhi i te pono i whakarerekē i ngā mea katoa.

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
